newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Raffles Medical offers 38 mln IPO shares at S$0.38.
newsitem.headline: Raffles Medical offers 38 mln IPO shares at S$0.38.

text.p: Healthcare company Raffles Medical Group said on Monday it was offering 38.04 million new shares at Singapore $0.38 each in its Singapore initial public offering (IPO).
Raffles Medical said in a statement that 28.53 million of the 38.04 million shares would offered to the public with 9.51 million placed privately.
The offer aimed to raise about S$13.5 million to finance expansion in Singapore and the region.
The company said the shares were being offered at a historical price earnings ratio of 21.1 times.
The offer would close on April 9, it said.
The issue is lead managed and underwritten by DBS Bank and co-underwritten by Overseas Union Bank.
